subject: Learning Methods
title: Slow Reading for Dense Material
description: One-minute skill: Slow Reading for Dense Material.

hook.text: A philosophy student tried to read Kant at normal pace. By page three she realized she hadn't understood page one.

buildup.text: Dense material demands slow, deliberate reading. Every sentence may carry a concept that requires full attention.

discovery.text: Effective slow reading means pausing to restate each paragraph's argument before continuing to the next.

twist.text: Reading dense material slowly actually saves time. Rushing creates the need to reread, doubling total time spent.

climax.text: Match speed to density. Simple text: fast. Technical text: slow. The variable pace maximizes understanding per minute.

punchline.text: Dense text demands slow speed. Racing wastes more time.

quiz.question: Why does slow reading of dense material save time overall?
options: Rushing creates the need to reread, which doubles total time
Slow readers remember everything on the first pass
